insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.note: Policy covers room rent up to Sum Insured with no stated room rent sub-limit; however if a higher room category than eligible is chosen, associated medical expenses are pro-rated. No specific room category restriction mentioned in base policy wording.

icu.note: ICU charges covered under Inpatient Care up to Sum Insured with no separate sub-limit stated.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment in base policy; co-payment is mentioned as applicable only if specified in Policy Schedule.

sub_limits.note: Most benefits covered up to Sum Insured. Modern treatments have a ₹1L sub-limit on certain robotic surgeries (excludable via Modern Treatment+ add-on). Emergency ambulance capped at ₹2,000/hospitalisation.

deductible.note: No base deductible; deductible applicable only if specified in Policy Schedule.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents covered from day 1.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 36 months of continuous coverage. Reducible via portability credit from prior insurer.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions (cataract, hernia, joint replacement, fibroids, etc.) excluded for 24 months. Accidents covered from day 1; cancer covered after 30-day wait.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses are a standard exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered. No optional maternity add-on mentioned.

cumulative_bonus.note: Booster Benefit: 50% of Base SI added per claim-free year, max 100% of Base SI. On a claim year, accumulated bonus reduced by 50% of expiring Base SI.

restoration.note: ReAssure benefit triggers from first paid claim and is available for all subsequent claims in the policy year for any/all insured persons. Max per single claim = Base SI. Covers inpatient, day care, domiciliary, AYUSH, modern treatments, organ donor, home care.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days preceding admission, reimbursement basis only.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 180 days after discharge, reimbursement basis only.

day_care.note: Day care treatment covered if admitted for more than 2 hours; includes angiography, dialysis, radiotherapy, chemotherapy.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered (reimbursement only) if treatment continues for at least 3 consecutive days and patient cannot be moved or hospital bed unavailable.

ayush.note: Ayurveda, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy covered for inpatient care in AYUSH hospitals up to Sum Insured. Yoga treatment not covered.

organ_donor.note: Living organ donor's inpatient harvesting expenses covered up to Sum Insured, subject to Transplantation of Human Organs Act compliance.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to ₹2,000 per hospitalisation. Air ambulance covered up to Sum Insured (cashless) or ₹2.5L (reimbursement).

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatments covered. Most at actuals up to SI; certain robotic surgeries capped at ₹1L unless Modern Treatment+ add-on is purchased.

consumables.note: Base policy excludes consumables (List I). Safeguard add-on covers List I non-payables; Safeguard+ covers Lists I–IV. Both are optional paid add-ons.

global_cover.note: All benefits available in India only. Air ambulance also restricted to India. Section 6.29 explicitly excludes treatment outside India.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration credits), no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days grace period for annual/non-monthly premium; 15 days for monthly instalment mode. Coverage available during grace period.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from date of receipt of policy document; applicable on new policies only, not renewals.

portability.note: Portability permitted as per IRDAI norms; waiting period credits transferred to new insurer.

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, hormone replacement therapy, sleep disorders, STIs (non-HIV), dental, external congenital anomaly, OPD, overseas treatment, circumcision

optional_riders.display: Personal Accident Cover, Hospital Cash, Safeguard (consumables + SI inflation), Safeguard+ (enhanced consumables), Modern Treatment+ (removes robotic sub-limit)
